item.title: IRGC Navy: Two violating oil tankers stopped in south of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has announced that two violating oil tankers, one in the eastern part and the other in the western part of the Strait of Hormuz, which intended to pass through an unauthorized route, suffered accidents and were stopped in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Baqaei condemns territorial claims by UAE and Canada regarding three Iranian islands
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has strongly condemned the claims made by the United Arab Emirates and Canada regarding the three Iranian islands—as stated in a joint declaration by the Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and the Prime Minister of Canada—and, while emphasizing that Abu Musa, Greater Tunb, and Lesser Tunb belong to Iran in perpetuity, characterized this action as contrary to the principles of the UN Charter and international law.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86307100/Baqaei-condemns-territorial-claims-by-UAE-and-Canada-regarding

Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has strongly condemned the claims made by the United Arab Emirates and Canada regarding the three Iranian islands—as stated in a joint declaration by the Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and the Prime Minister of Canada—and, while emphasizing that Abu Musa, Greater Tunb, and Lesser Tunb belong to Iran in perpetuity, characterized this action as contrary to the principles of the UN Charter and international law.
